A-grade office unveiled at Robina
Retail
|
Dec 20, 2022

QIC Real Estate has unveiled its newest A-grade office building at Robina Town Centre on the Gold Coast, delivering the latest landmark in its transformative Robina Town Centre masterplan. 

Share

Incorporating state-of-the-art end-of-trip facilities and a ground floor cafe, the office accomodation benefits from unrivalled access to the retail, hospitality and transport amenity at the Robina Town Centre. The building’s façade bears a multi-storey mural by local Indigenous artist Goompi Ugerabah that depicts the importance of nearby waterways and the rainforest environment to the heritage and future of the Gold Coast.

 

“This new commercial offer at Robina is further evidence of our commitment to a thriving, multifaceted and future-facing town centre on the Gold Coast,” said Daryl Stubbings, QIC Real Estate’s Director - Australian Investment Management. “We are at an exciting juncture in the evolution of Robina Town Centre, and this vital new hub of business and public services will bring new depth to our connection with the local community.”
